cases.disposition_reason: editor strip before a tab change, with Overview active and Import still open
cases.action_sequence: Capture the editor strip with Overview active, select orders.sql, move to Import and close it, then jump with 1, open a tab with n, open the overflow menu, jump with 2, and cancel, discard, and save the dirty orders.sql tab.
cases.expected_results: The before strip keeps Import open. After the close, Export is visible and Import is gone. Digit 1 returns to Overview, n opens untitled-1.sql, and digit 2 returns to orders.sql while untitled-1.sql scrolls off. Esc keeps orders.sql, Discard closes it, and Save closes it while Import stays.
cases.forbidden_effects: Closing Import opens the unsaved dialog. Digit 2 leaves untitled-1.sql on the visible strip. Discard or Save leaves orders.sql on the strip.

acceptance_receipt.precondition: editor strip before a tab change, with Overview active and Import still open

acceptance_receipt_also.precondition: editor strip after selecting Import and closing it, with Export visible
